svg.text: Scale 1:25 @ A1 · looking north from the FF hall
Two-step polyurethane panel moulding, mitred corners, PU adhesive + pins,
painted in situ with the wall colour (satin) — tone-on-tone, no contrast colour.
Inner square = outer ÷ 1.618 (golden ratio). The 37 mm band between the
lines is half the 75 mm gap between squares: a 2 : 1 rhythm across the wall.
10 × 6 gold-anodised aluminium flat bar on the dark-painted
reveal back, centred, 17 mm behind the pilaster face. Continuous
plinth → crown (one butt joint at the datum gap).
Replaces LED: no wiring, no driver, no maintenance.
• A up-wash: strip behind a 30 mm walnut upstand, grazes the TV zone
• B under-glow: strip set back 40 mm — the console "floats"
• 8 mm gold edge strip on the front bottom edge
• one 24 V circuit, 60 W driver inside the console, dimmable
• steel French cleat into masonry (structural check by architect)
stepped MDF crown, 12 mm gold fillet
Existing masonry; 20 mm plaster finish coat + putty. Matte emulsion, deep navy
(design ref. sRGB #22385B — approve from a 1 m² site sample in hall daylight).
4 × 11, 298 mm outer (M1) + 184 mm inner (M2), 75 mm gaps; grid 1417 wide,
centred; one gap centred on the SF floor datum (3 rows below, 8 above).
208 × 25 mm MDF, PU satin, deeper navy (#1A2C48); single M1 panels 140 wide,
breaks aligned to the gold rule, the datum gap and the row 6|7 gap.
10 × 6 flat bar in both reveals (2 × 6.29 m) + 1417 × 12 rule at +2016 +
12 mm crown fillet. Gold-anodised aluminium (brass-PVD optional). Nowhere else.
All lines painted in situ, same navy as their ground (satin vs matte).
55" class (≈1220 × 686), centre +1270; low-profile fixed bracket; single M1
frame 1417 × 930 = grid width. Sockets: 2 behind TV; 2 + LAN inside console.
25 Ø PVC chased TV → console before plastering (power + HDMI).
Walnut veneer on 18 ply, 1600 × 305 × 356, underside +305, wall-hung on a
steel French cleat. 500 doors | 600 fluted centre | 500 doors. Gold edge strip.
Only in the console: 2 × ~1.5 m COB, 24 V, 2700–3000 K, CRI ≥ 90, in alu
profiles with opal diffusers; one 60 W driver inside; dimmable. ~3 m total.
Existing linen drum cluster in the void, globes at +3600 … +4400.
Full-height scaffold; set out the grid from the centreline and the datum.
Budget logic: the field is paint + moulding (cheapest per m²); spend goes
to the pilasters, the gold lines and the console — where the eye lands.
1. All dimensions in mm unless noted. Levels from FF finished floor level (±0).
2. Design-intent drawing for discussion — architect / structural engineer to verify
wall construction, fixings, scaffold and all services before construction.
3. Verify wall width (2221) and FF → soffit height (6556) on site; set out from
the wall centreline (A–A) and the SF floor datum (+3353).
4. Do not scale. Renders: renders/media-wall/*.jpg (same model, same dimensions).
G+2 residence — first floor hall, double-height void
Rev A — design intent, for discussion
